content.title: About
content.content: Cereal flavored puffs are light, airy snacks made from corn, rice and oat flour, baked to a golden crunch and coated with a natural flavor glaze (e.g., berry, chocolate or vanilla). Perfect for a quick bite or to add to milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cereal puffs first appeared in the early 1990s as an alternative to traditional dry cereals.
The flavor glaze uses only natural flavor extracts and a modest amount of sugar.
A single serving (30 g) provides about 120 kcal, making it a convenient on‑the‑go snack.
When labeled “gluten‑free,” the product contains no wheat, barley or rye, suitable for people with celiac disease.
The packaging is made from recyclable plastic to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Corn and oat bases deliver slow‑releasing energy, helping to maintain satiety.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Thiamine, riboflavin and niacin are present, supporting metabolic processes.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The puffs contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Oat ingredients add fiber that promotes healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Natural flavorings such as berry or chocolate often bring flavonoids that combat free radicals.

items.title: Allergy to corn or oats
items.content: Individuals allergic to these grains may experience reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although modest, the sugar may be a concern for people with diabetes.

items.title: Moisture‑related spoilage
items.content: Improper storage can cause the puffs to absorb moisture and develop mold.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the puffs dry as a snack, stir them into milk, yogurt or smoothies, or use them as a crunchy topping for desserts and as a coating for fried foods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. For extended storage, refrigerate to prevent moisture absorption.
